desktop_lifetime.scope:
Keep a normal desktop permission boundary across fresh native GUI processes.

The hosted service desktop initially grants access through Administrators only.
Keep the existing fixture's own-user grant for the full batch so shared Windows
input services do not lose desktop access between app exits. Restore both exact
original ACLs once at the end, including after failure. Each GUI still receives
its own restricted medium token, process job and independent recovery fixture.

desktop_permissions.scope: full desktop/window-station access for the owned disposable account only; exact original ACLs restored

proofs.scope:
Actual Windows UI Automation from fresh settings to selected ZIP recovery.

The default suite verifies UIA actions and names. --keyboard uses SendInput;
--ime additionally activates the installed Microsoft Japanese IME and tests
Roman-key conversion and cancellation. This does not test a screen-reader
product. Only owned processes and fixture files are touched; temporary input
settings and desktop permissions are restored. Failed-tree evidence is kept.
